input: 1280x720 grayscale, 640x360 scene processing; negotiated camera mode not recorded
scene: User-operated live trial; images and physical movement annotations unavailable
warmup: No explicit benchmark warmup; first 67 observations precede enrollment

orientation_discrepancy.definition: 2*acos(abs(dot(unit reference quaternion, unit query quaternion))) in degrees
orientation_discrepancy.note: Visual overlap is not identical camera angle. No physical ground truth or images; do not attribute the discrepancy solely to drift or accept gyro orientation as verified.

limits: Rates describe scene updates only. Compute is wall time, not CPU; host completion excludes exposure/browser latency. No CPU, RSS, thermal or full-pipeline measurements. Dirty tree provenance. No visual ground truth, so known/unknown counts are not accuracy or success rate.
decision: Live wiring and cadence demonstrated. Keep thresholds unchanged. Obtain movement confirmation and paired image evidence before treating revisits or orientation consistency as validated.
